The north quay closes at dusk through the winter season, and vessels waiting for a berth anchor in the outer roads until called in.
The pilot boat keeps its usual hours, and the night signal is shown from the breakwater light from the first of the month onwards.
Vessels leaving after dark report to the harbor office by radio before they cast off, and again once they are clear of the breakwater.
